hero.title: Telegram advertising without personal messages and waiting
hero.subtitle: AutoAd is an ecosystem for automating Telegram advertising. We eliminated personal chats for admins and long response times for advertisers. All transactions happen through a unified user balance.

pain_points.title: Tired of these problems?
pain_points.point2: Afraid of scam when buying ads?
pain_points.point3: Tired of paying for each post separately?

step1.title: Step 01
step1.detail: No need to pay for each post separately. Top up your internal wallet through available gateways (TON/USDT, Telegram Stars, or fiat integrations).

step2.title: Step 02
step2.description: Book slot in a few clicks
step2.detail: Smart calendar system: admin sets weekly rules (e.g., Mon: 12:00, 18:00), bot generates the grid. Soft booking reserves slot for 15 minutes.

step3.title: Step 03
step3.detail: Automated posting and 24-hour monitoring ensure your ad stays live as agreed.

result.title: Result
result.detail: Money is held in escrow until post is published and verified, then released to admin's withdrawable balance.

feature1.title: Unified Wallet
feature1.description: Internal balance system with crypto, Stars, and fiat support
feature1.detail: Top up once, use everywhere. Instant refunds to your app balance if admin rejects (pre-moderation), no waiting for bank/blockchain returns.

feature2.title: Smart Calendar
feature2.description: Automated slot grid generation for admins
feature2.detail: Set weekly rules, add exceptions in clicks. Soft booking system with 15-minute reservation windows.

feature3.title: Escrow Protection
feature3.description: Automated payment security for both parties
feature3.detail: Funds held until publication verified. 24-hour monitoring ensures compliance before releasing payments to admin.

feature4.title: Transparent Economics
feature4.description: Clear fee structure and fast withdrawals
feature4.detail: 5% service fee + 1.5% top-up fee. Crypto withdrawals from 50 USDT, processed instantly to 24h for large amounts.

economics.title: Economics & Withdrawals
economics.service_fee: Service commission: 5% per successful deal + 1.5% on balance top-up
economics.min_withdrawal: Minimum withdrawal: from 50 USDT or equivalent
economics.withdrawal_methods: Withdrawal methods: TON, USDT (TRC-20/BEP-20) and other integrated systems
economics.withdrawal_speed: Withdrawal speed: from instant (crypto) to 24 hours (manual moderation for large amounts)

security.title: Security & Technology
security.transaction_layer: PostgreSQL stores complete balance change history with unique IDs and audit logs
security.payment_queues: Redis/Celery for processing withdrawal requests and payment API interactions
security.security_features: Two-factor verification for withdrawal details changes and admin violation tracking system

q1.question: Why top up balance instead of paying directly?
q1.answer: It's faster. If admin rejects your post (pre-moderation), money instantly returns to your app balance, and you can immediately buy placement in another channel without waiting for bank/blockchain refunds.

q2.question: How to withdraw earnings?
q2.answer: In 'My Channels / Wallet' section, specify amount and choose available method (crypto at launch). When minimum threshold is reached, request goes to processing.

q3.question: What if I topped up balance but changed my mind about buying ads?
q3.answer: You can request withdrawal back to your wallet minus payment system fees.
